task: Give your agents persistent memory they can save, recall and correct

x-display.title: Keep memory across your agents
x-display.summary: Save facts with their sources and recall them in another conversation or agent.
x-display.description:
Ask your agent to remember a preference, project decision or useful fact. GBrain keeps an explicit record that your connected agents can recall later, with the source of each fact. You can correct a record or withdraw it while keeping its history.

This starts in keyless mode: saved facts and keyword retrieval need no model account. A local Postgres database lets separate agent connections share the same memory. Optional embedding, synthesis and background enrichment are left off until you deliberately configure them.

packaging_note: Uses pinned upstream source and its lockfile, Bun 1.4.4 and a persistent pgvector/Postgres database. Uses GBrain's own non-interactive init, CLI and stdio MCP server; no host hooks, account bootstrap or background enrichment are installed.

commands.name: gbrain
commands.what: GBrain's command line for this local memory database

mcp_servers.what: GBrain's memory tools, sharing the same saved facts across agent connections

access.why: The tools connect to their local database. Network access also permits providers you explicitly configure later; none is configured by default.

known_issues: All AI apps connected to this local GBrain share its memory. This is not separation between different people or permission groups.
Keyless mode stores explicit facts and supports keyword retrieval. Semantic search, synthesis and enrichment need separate provider configuration and may have costs; this setup does not enable them.
The database and configuration survive stopping the tools. Use UGT's stop command to stop the recipe's database. Removing the recipe preserves its data unless you explicitly delete the data.

Setup proves remember, recall, correction and withdrawal using synthetic facts, then expires those facts. GBrain retains their audit history. It does not install hooks or rewrite your agent's existing instructions.
